nodes.text: explore 0 (web-domain-researcher 0): One explore sub-agent fetches `http://localhost:30333/api/data.json` exactly once and returns the complete benchmark payload with field and count controls. Do not query WooCommerce, write files, or run the processor.

explore 1 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): One explore sub-agent exhausts the required WooCommerce products and orders with `perPage` at most 100 and terminal-page checks. Paginate `woo_products_list` and `woo_orders_list` with increasing literal `page` until a short or empty terminal page proves exhaustion; omit the optional order `status` and preserve every observed status. Return compact product and order records plus page/count/null/duplicate controls. Do not modify the store, write files, or run the processor.

coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): The coder sub-agent receives both frozen payloads and uniquely owns the required JSON inputs, `wc_yf_finance_processor.py`, and `wc_yf_finance_results.json`. Derive only source-supported category comparisons. Run and read back the processor result, then return its path/hash, source/page/count controls, eligible categories, exact metrics, and schema checks. It must not fetch localhost or WooCommerce and must not create Excel or Word outputs.

coder 0 (office-report-builder 1): One coder sub-agent is the sole writer of `Yf_Financial_Report.xlsx`. Read only the verified processor result. Create exactly `Data_Analysis`, `Metrics`, and `Recommendations`: `Data_Analysis` has literal columns `Category, Our_Avg_Price, Market_Avg_Price, Price_Gap_Pct` sorted alphabetically by Category; `Metrics` has `Metric, Value` with source-reconciled counts, averages, and key statistics; `Recommendations` contains source-supported priority actions. Write literal values and read back every populated range.

coder 1 (office-report-builder 2): One coder sub-agent is the sole writer of `Yf_Financial_Analysis.docx`. Read only the verified processor result. Create the required executive summary, key findings, and recommendations sections, ground every quantitative claim in the result, and read back its heading structure, tables, and full text.
